# Ziiro AI

> Ziiro AI is a business-intelligence-first AI consultancy for startups, solo
> founders, and founder-led teams. We start with how your business actually
> operates and only build technology when the numbers prove it's worth it.
> Every engagement ships a working, measured system, not a slide deck.

The order is the product: understand the business, find the bottlenecks,
quantify the ROI, then build only what the numbers justify. We turn down work
when the math doesn't support it.

## Start here
- [Ziiro AI](https://ziiro.work): AI that has to pay for itself. The agent directory behind the work — the jobs, agents and departments we actually run — and the ask: an hourly business intelligence session.
- [Contact](https://ziiro.work/contact): Book a paid business intelligence consultation, billed hourly with a 60-minute minimum, at rates set by region (India, United States, and a global rate). We identify your operational bottlenecks, estimate the ROI of automating them, show where AI actually creates value, and say what shouldn't be automated. No pitch, and you keep the roadmap. aniket@ziiro.work · govind@ziiro.work · Haryana, India · worldwide.

## Watch
- [How Ziiro works, in full](https://ziiro.work/watch/how-ziiro-works): An eight-minute screen-share walkthrough of the whole business in the order you'd actually ask about it: what we do and what we deliberately don't, how an engagement runs start to finish, what you invest and how scope gets set, and where your data goes and who can see it.

## What we do
- [Products](https://ziiro.work/products): Five systems: Agentic Systems (custom AI operators for research, routing, follow-ups, reporting), Self-Optimizing Systems (marketing, outreach, website, and workflow loops that track outcomes and auto-tune), Business Intelligence (KPI baselines, dashboards, ROI models, priority matrices), AI Strategy Sprint (roadmap to the highest-leverage system to build first), and Role Analyzer (people-fit diagnostic for founder-led teams).
- [Docs](https://ziiro.work/docs): The reference page. How to get started, the five systems with typical build times, the AI Transformation Audit's seven phases and terms, the pricing FAQs, the eight-minute walkthrough, what a Full Build includes, and the eight-layer stack. Guides, use cases and integration, data-handling and security documentation are marked as in progress.
- [Pricing](https://ziiro.work/pricing): No fixed packages. Two scopes: Strategy Sprint (1-3 weeks: audit, process mapping, KPI baselines, ROI models, priority matrix, roadmap) and Full Build (4-12 weeks: everything in the Sprint plus agentic system design and deployment, self-optimizing loops, integration with your stack, dashboards, and ongoing measurement). Projects are priced by the system shipped, not by the hour; the initial consultation is billed hourly.

## Who it's for
- SaaS and software startups, solo founders, founder-led agencies, consulting and professional services, and AI-first service businesses. Lean teams, roughly 5-500 people, that want measurable outcomes rather than AI for its own sake.

## Company
- [Who We Are](https://ziiro.work/who-we-are): A small, operator-led team, and how we work with you: the engagement phase by phase, from understanding how the business runs to a prioritized roadmap, and how to reach the team directly. An eight-minute screen-share walkthrough of how Ziiro works end to end (what we do, how we work, what you invest, where your data goes), why we started: too many companies buying AI like a lottery ticket, with nobody doing the boring part first; and the eight-layer stack we build on, in which the reasoning model is one interchangeable layer rather than the advantage.
- [Mission](https://ziiro.work/mission): We don't sell AI, we sell results. AI without business intelligence is expensive guessing.
